gloss: specifics; detailed discussion of each point

definitions.gloss: specifics; detailed discussion of each point
definitions.explanation: Discussion of each individual point or topic, as opposed to {総論|そうろん} (general remarks). Also the topic-by-topic part of a textbook or course.

examples.japanese: {各論|かくろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{総論|そうろん}→総論：24125_souron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{各論|かくろん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれた→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone agreed in principle, but opinions split on the details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{総論|そうろん}→総論：24125_souron⟧、⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧ごと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各論|かくろん}になっている。
examples.english: The first half of the textbook covers general principles, the second half each disease in turn.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{総論|そうろん}→総論：24125_souron⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧、{各論|かくろん}⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧: agreeing in principle but objecting to the specifics — a common complaint about reforms
- {各論|かくろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to get down to specifics

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{総論|そうろん}→総論：24125_souron⟧: general remarks, overview — the opposite
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧: details — the general word
